items.title: Tony Fougerat Interview, 1960-06-08
items.q: Played for... Played for... Loey Primer played out on Burden Street there.

ctx.x: Yeah. About that style of clarinet like Skaggs.

Yeah, yeah. And, uh... Well, all in all, of course, after playing around here, all them years, I made Burden Street up and down the street. Played Silver Slipper in the old days. And, uh... Played for... Played for... Loey Primer played out on Burden Street there. It's right across from the... From the... Show Bar. You know that club right across the street? I forgot the name of it.
